component.name: ShadowCode
component.summary: Run coding agents and local models in one workspace

description.p: ShadowCode brings coding agents and local GGUF models into one desktop workspace. Choose a model for each task, review proposed changes, and decide when commands may run.

Use supported coding tools through their existing sign-ins, an OpenRouter API key, or compatible local models run by the bundled llama.cpp runtime. Conversations, changes, and task checks stay visible in the same project.

ul.li: Approve actions, then review, keep or undo each change a task made.
Run tasks side by side in Git worktrees, or compare models on the same task.
Shell commands run in a sandbox that hides your home folder.

description.p: Less-frequent composer controls move under More, finished tasks refresh their check results after edits, and the documentation and screenshots match the current app.
Reliability and daily workflow: an editor with drafts, Run a check on finished tasks, sign-in recovery, safer Compare and the first signed release.
Subagents, code intelligence, a real shell sandbox, parallel tasks, remote access, editor integration, automations, preview and voice input.
